_help: package.json: short names for the questionnaire's flow tools, for people who use npm.
WHAT IT IS FOR: 'npm run validate-flow' checks the flow, 'npm run flow-map' rewrites docs/flow.md (the map of the flow), and 'npm run simulate -- --set nps=4 --set support_gate=no' tries out answers.
HOW TO RUN: in Terminal, in the project folder (the one with web/ and scripts/). Without npm, the same works as: python3 scripts/flow.py check | map --write | simulate ...
READS / WRITES: see the header of scripts/flow.js. Only flow-map writes a file (docs/flow.md).
It installs NOTHING: there are no dependencies, so 'npm install' is never needed here. The developer tests have their own package.json in tests/.
Notes for humans start with an underscore, like this one; npm ignores them.
name: valmo-partner-pulse
description: Valmo Partner Pulse: shortcuts for the questionnaire's flow tools (scripts/flow.js). No dependencies.
